source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1961, p. 1 ("Unopposed returns at Cookstown")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the unopposed-returns report read in the Mid-Ulster Mail of 20 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Cookstown Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Sixteen candidates were returned unopposed for the sixteen seats; the Mid-Ulster Mail prints the full list with the divisions they represent. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Mid-Ulster Mail, 20 May 1961, p. 1 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the paper prints 'James P. Duffy, C.B.E., J.P. (Coagh)', a misprint; the surname is filed as Duff, as Coagh's member is printed in 1946-58 and 1964-67 (Mid-Ulster Mail, 23 May 1964, p. 1: 'James P. Duff, C.B.E., J.P. (Coagh)'). Name_As_Printed keeps the printed form.
